prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate design board B for Brazilian native Android/iPhone volleyball multicamera replay app "Outro Ângulo". EXACTLY THREE full portrait app screens front-on side by side, 390:844 proportions each, equal sizes, no perspective and no hardware phone frames. Landscape board with tiny heading "B — Guiado". All text Portuguese, real native app usability, generous 48px touch targets. Colors fixed warm white #F7F7F2, graphite #17212B, white #FFFFFF, primary blue #2456D8. Replay dark #15191F. System sans typography, moderate 12px rounding. No gradients, neon, glows, textures, excess badges, decorative charts. Small brand symbol two framing corners. This option is COMPACT AND GUIDED, using numbered setup steps and useful camera preview content as the main hierarchy rather than a large diagram or marketing headline. Premium functional craftsmanship.
Screen 1: warm white background, small wordmark Outro Ângulo. Header "Vamos para o jogo?" 3-step horizontal progress "1 Modalidade", "2 Celulares", "3 Pronto" with first active. A substantial segmented sport selection "Quadra" / "Praia". Simple short explanatory rows "1 Escolha a modalidade", "2 Conecte dois celulares", "3 Reveja qualquer lance", no icons inside colored squares. A quiet outlined volleyball court illustration occupies small supporting space. Anchored bottom blue button "Criar partida", white outlined "Entrar como câmera". Footnote "Os celulares precisam estar na mesma rede."
Screen 2: warm white background, back nav then heading "Tudo pronto". Small subtitle "Vôlei de quadra". Two generous landscape preview panels stacked vertically showing the SAME amateur indoor volleyball court seen from DIFFERENT cameras (baseline and sideline), photoreal, not identical photos. Each with unobtrusive caption below "1 · Este celular" and "2 · Câmera de fundo", text status "Gravando". Small neutral progress indicator and label "40 s disponíveis para revisão". Bottom anchored broad blue button "Revisar lance", secondary "Ajustar câmeras".
Screen 3: dark immersive replay, "Revisar lance" header. Large volleyball court video still occupying top middle, no simulated measurement overlays. Below wide timeline and elapsed time "00:24 / 00:40", large playback controls. Camera selection as TWO SMALL video thumbnails with labels "Câmera 1" and "Câmera 2", selected outlined in blue. Speed "0,5×" and plain "Ajustar sincronia". Bottom blue button "Retomar partida". All controls clear, not dense. Show full screen height and safe areas. No extra screens, no marketing statistics, no subscriptions, no uppercase tactical jargon.
